description: BD ORTHO® - Seine-Maritime - 2015 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The product BD ORTHO® V2 is a collection of digital orthophotography mosaics in color or Infra Red colors, rectified in the projection adapted to the covered territory. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include BD Ortho, ortho-imagerie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
